/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'EOF'
const base = 'http://127.0.0.1:3217'
const checks = [
  ['home', '/', {}, 200, ['Welcome to My Blog', 'TestAgent/1.0', '<title>Home - My Blog</title>']],
  ['blog index', '/blog', {}, 200, ['All Blog Posts', '<title>Blog - My Blog</title>']],
  ['generated post', '/blog/1', {}, 200, ['Comments (5)', '<title>sunt aut facere repellat provident occaecati excepturi optio reprehenderit - My Blog</title>']],
  ['on-demand post', '/blog/11', {}, 200, ['Comments (5)']],
  ['missing post', '/blog/999', {}, 404, ['404 - Page Not Found']],
  ['unknown route', '/no-such-route', {}, 404, ['404 - Page Not Found']],
  ['posts GET', '/api/posts', {}, 200, ['First Post']],
  ['posts POST', '/api/posts', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ title: 'New', content: 'Text' }) }, 201, ['New']],
  ['posts invalid POST', '/api/posts', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: '{}' }, 400, ['Title and content are required']],
  ['post GET', '/api/posts/5', {}, 200, ['Post 5']],
  ['post PUT', '/api/posts/5', { method: 'PUT', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ title: 'Updated' }) }, 200, ['Updated']],
  ['post DELETE', '/api/posts/5', { method: 'DELETE' }, 200, ['Post 5 deleted successfully']],
  ['unsupported method', '/api/posts', { method: 'PUT' }, 405, []],
]
let failures = 0
for (const [name, path, options, expectedStatus, snippets] of checks) {
  const response = await fetch(base + path, { headers: { 'user-agent': 'TestAgent/1.0', ...options.headers }, ...options })
  const text = await response.text()
  const ok = response.status === expectedStatus && snippets.every((snippet) => text.includes(snippet))
  console.log("'`${ok ? '"'PASS' : 'FAIL'} "'${name}: ${response.status}${name === '"'unsupported method' ? "'` allow=${response.headers.get('"'allow')}"'` : '"''}"'`)
  if (!ok) failures++
}
process.exitCode = failures ? 1 : 0
EOF'

  ['/', 'GET', 200, null],
  ['/blog', 'GET', 200, null],

  ['/not-a-route', 'GET', 404, null],
  ['/api/posts', 'GET', 200, null],
  ['/api/posts', 'PUT', 405, 'GET, POST'],
  ['/api/posts', 'OPTIONS', 405, 'GET, POST'],
  ['/api/posts/5', 'GET', 200, null],
  ['/api/posts/5', 'POST', 405, 'GET, PUT, DELETE'],
  ['/api/posts/5', 'OPTIONS', 405, 'GET, PUT, DELETE'],
]
for (const [path, method, status, allow] of cases) {
  const response = await fetch("'`http://127.0.0.1:3217${path}`, { method })
  const ok = response.status === status && (!allow || response.headers.get('"'allow') === allow)
  console.log("'`${ok ? '"'PASS' : 'FAIL'} "'${method} ${path}: ${response.status} ${response.headers.get('"'allow') ?? ''}"'`)
